info.title: Verified Service Marketplace — Provider review responses
info.description: Extends customer-reviews.openapi.json. Exactly one immutable provider response per Published review of a Completed booking. Active verified-email Owner/Staff only; booking customers cannot reply to themselves. Replies never change customer ratings.

post.summary: Publish the provider organization's single response

comment.description: Trimmed UTF-16 code units; line breaks/tabs allowed, other controls rejected.

201.description: Response saved with private organization audit. Location points to the participant review resource.

400.description: Invalid feedback, missing consent/CSRF or unknown fields

403.description: Unverified email, self-response or invalid frontend-proxy origin

404.description: Missing review/booking, wrong organization, inactive membership or not Owner/Staff

409.description: Existing response, Hidden review or non-completed booking; reload before retrying

get.summary: Read participant-only review plus provider response eligibility

404.description: Unknown booking or not an active participant
